title: ResponsibleRobotBench: Benchmarking Responsible Robot Manipulation using Multi-modal Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on evaluating the safety, reliability, and risk-awareness of robotic manipulation systems in physically hazardous environments (e.g., electrical, chemical, human-related physical hazards).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its scope is limited to the physical safety and operational responsibility of robotic systems.
